interpretation.stable_canopy: Seasonal NDVI variation is small (~0.05), indicating evergreen forest
interpretation.slight_summer_peak: Higher NDVI in wet season (Oct-Apr) reflects leaf flush + active growth
interpretation.drought_resilience: Even in dry season, NDVI stays >0.72 — forest does not defoliate
interpretation.marketing_angle: "Our forest stays green 365 days/year" — true, supported by 5 years of satellite data
